rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A table listing the parts of publication such as a book or technical specification, and the pages on which these content elements start (if the publication is printed or otherwise organized into pages), usually listed in order of appearance.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A table of contents typically includes first-level headers, such as the chapter titles of a book, and may also include second- and even third-level headers. In electronic works, the table of contents entries are often internally hyperlinked to the content items, so that clicking on the entry takes the reader to that item.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: table of contents
